bar.flat: Flat shading: one tone per face, to read the topology
ch.shaded: Physical render: the lit material, as it will come out
ch.unlit: Painted, unlit: the texture as authored (U)
ch.albedo: Base colour only, no light and no other maps
ch.normalMap: Normal map: the relief painted in the texture
ch.normalGeom: Geometry normals: the relief of the mesh itself
ch.uv: UV checker: where the texture stretches and repeats
ch.clay: Clay: neutral gray, to read the wireframe better
bar.wireOnly: Wire only, no faces: see the structure through
bar.wireDark: Dark rather than light lines, for a light model
giz.translate: Move the object (G) — click again to put the handles away
giz.rotate: Rotate the object (R) — click again to put the handles away
giz.scale: Scale the object (S) — click again to put the handles away
cam.free: Free camera: leave the centre, pivot in place, move forward (V)
cam.turntable: Continuous rotation: the model turns on a stand (T)
pan.shellHint: Thumbnails of 3D files in Explorer, rendered by this copy of Albedo. Nothing is written until you ask for it.
empty.title: Drop a model
